tools.name: activate_design
tools.title: Approve a design for printing
tools.description: Approve a design for printing so it can be ordered (its print files go to production). First show the person the design (get_mockup) and ask; call this only after they say yes. Owner or Manager only; free.

tools.name: create_design
tools.title: Create a design
tools.description: Make a NEW design: uploaded artwork placed on the front and/or back of a garment. To show or order a design that already exists, find it with list_designs first; don't create a new design for the same artwork. Ask the person what to call it (title) and list every warning code in acknowledgedWarnings. A new design is not approved for printing until activate_design.

garment.description: A garment code: GD64, CC17, LS14, or one stocked for this account alone (list_garments lists every one it can use)

title.description: The merchant's name for the design

placementModel.description: collar-v1 = placed by the collar with an optional adjust; hem-v1 = Low hem (preset low-hem); omitted = a print-area placement.

placement.description: print-area-v1 only: size and position in inches inside the print area.

topOffsetIn.description: Inches from the top of the print area

centerXIn.description: Inches from the center line; 0 = centered

adjust.description: collar-v1 only; omit for the rule as is.

dyIn.description: Inches; + = down, away from the collar

scale.description: Fraction of the rule's size, above 0 and at most 1

align.description: box = true center, visual = ink-weighted center

preset.description: Print position instead of adjust, e.g. left-chest. low-hem: Low hem, only on accounts that have it turned on: a small print just above the bottom hem (the LS14 hoodie: low on the front pocket), front only, nothing else to send.

placementModel.description: collar-v1 = placed by the collar with an optional adjust; hem-v1 = Low hem (preset low-hem); omitted = a print-area placement.

placement.description: print-area-v1 only: size and position in inches inside the print area.

topOffsetIn.description: Inches from the top of the print area

centerXIn.description: Inches from the center line; 0 = centered

adjust.description: collar-v1 only; omit for the rule as is.

dyIn.description: Inches; + = down, away from the collar

scale.description: Fraction of the rule's size, above 0 and at most 1

align.description: box = true center, visual = ink-weighted center

preset.description: Print position instead of adjust, e.g. left-chest. low-hem: Low hem, only on accounts that have it turned on: a small print just above the bottom hem (the LS14 hoodie: low on the front pocket), front only, nothing else to send.

acknowledgedWarnings.description: Every warning code the artwork or placement raised

tools.name: create_estimate
tools.title: Estimate a print run
tools.description: A quick nonbinding price for approved designs (design, size, quantity), shipping included. Creates nothing: when the person asks for an order, use create_order instead (drafting is free).

tools.name: create_order
tools.title: Create a draft order
tools.description: Create a draft order for one US recipient and get its total (offer.totalCents, shipping included). Drafting is free, so no need to ask first; nothing is charged: tell the person the total and ask before paying (nextStep says how). Leave out storeId (the direct-order store is used) and externalReference (one is made) unless you have them.

storeId.description: Leave out for the direct-order store

externalReference.description: Your own unique id for this order; one is made when left out

country.description: US (the only country we ship to)

title.description: Line title, e.g. the design name

retailLineTotal.description: Optional: what your customer paid for this line, for your revenue figure only

RetailLineTotal.description: Optional. What your customer paid for this line in total (quantity × your price, after discounts, before tax and shipping): integer cents (amount × 100) and an upper-case ISO 4217 currency. Informational only: it counts toward your revenue figure and never changes the quote, the charge or what is printed. It is not part of the replay body, so a replay that differs only here returns the existing order.

tools.name: create_support_request
tools.title: Open a support request
tools.description: Send support a message about an order; you get a reference back. Support replies by email to the person on the account, not here.

tools.name: discard_order
tools.title: Discard a draft order
tools.description: Throw away an order that was never paid (no payment tried). Cannot be undone.

tools.name: generate_design
tools.title: Generate a design with AI
tools.description: Draw a design with AI. With reference ids (upload_design_reference) it recreates it closely and brief says only what to change; without, brief describes the design (what it shows, exact words, style). Uses 1 of the account's 20 free AI images a month (at most 15 a day); nothing is charged. Then poll get_generation_job until status is review. Only use images and text the person owns or may use (Toolbox POD Terms of Service).

garment.description: A garment code: GD64, CC17, LS14, or one stocked for this account alone (list_garments)

colorCodes.description: Optional: the shirt color it is drawn for, usually one code

tools.name: get_checkout_link
tools.title: Get a link to pay for an order
tools.description: A link to the Toolbox POD website where the person, signed in, reviews an order's total and pays for it (a draft, quoted or payment-held order). Changes nothing and charges nothing; only the account Owner can pay there.

orderId.description: The order's id (ord_…) or its number (1042 or #1042)

tools.name: get_design
tools.title: Get a design
tools.description: One design: its sides and placement, warnings, whether it is approved for printing and whether production has its print files. withHashes adds its exact print spec and two hashes. The client shows these pictures to the person: refer to each by its label, and never write a preview link as a markdown image. Give it as a plain link only if the person asks to open or download it, or can't see it, and do not generate, draw or edit your own version of the shirt, design or product.

withHashes.description: Add specificationHash and warningsHash (optional pins for activate_design)

tools.name: get_generation_job
tools.title: Get an AI design job
tools.description: An AI design job: its status, versions and nextStep. Judge versions once it is in review: then use_design_version, try_another_version or request_design_changes. When ready, artworkId goes to create_design.

tools.name: get_mockup
tools.title: Show a design on a shirt
tools.description: Show a design on a shirt in one color and side, as a picture the client shows to the person: call it by its label. To show an existing design, find it with list_designs first. For a model wearing it, pass look: a model look from list_mockup_looks, in a color it has. Give previews[].url as a plain link, only if they ask to open or download it (it expires in 24 hours); never write it as a markdown image. Free: our own photos. If a look or color is refused, offer the ones that exist; never generate a picture of the design yourself.

colorCode.description: Color code (BLK) or name (Black) of the design's garment

look.description: A look ref from list_mockup_looks or a template ref from list_mockup_templates

tools.name: get_order
tools.title: Get an order
tools.description: One order, by its id or its number (#1042): its lines, quote (quoteId and totalCents), status and hold reason, packages and tracking, the latest payment attempt and its production state.

orderId.description: The order's id (ord_…) or its number (1042 or #1042)

tools.name: get_rates
tools.title: Get prices
tools.description: The price list in cents: one shirt per garment and size, one- or two-sided, plus one flat shipping fee per order. Ships to the 50 US states and DC only. For a total, don't add it up yourself: use create_estimate or create_order.

tools.name: list_artwork
tools.title: List uploaded artwork
tools.description: Uploaded artwork, newest first (also files uploaded on the website), each with its artwork id for create_design and its warnings. search matches part of the filename; artworkId gives one file with how large it prints.

limit.description: How many, newest first (default 20, at most 50).

tools.name: list_designs
tools.title: List designs
tools.description: The account's designs, newest first, each with its id (for get_mockup and create_order), name, garment, sides and approved (true = can be ordered). query finds one by name. Look here before creating a design: a new design starts unapproved. The client shows these pictures to the person: refer to each by its label, and never write a preview link as a markdown image. Give it as a plain link only if the person asks to open or download it, or can't see it, and do not generate, draw or edit your own version of the shirt, design or product.

query.description: Part of the design's name (or its id), case-insensitive.

status.description: approved: approved for printing; draft: not approved yet.

garment.description: A garment code: GD64, CC17, LS14, or one stocked for this account alone (list_garments lists every one it can use)

limit.description: How many, newest first (default 20, at most 50).

tools.name: list_garments
tools.title: List garments
tools.description: What you can print on (GD64, CC17, …), with their color codes and names, sizes, print areas in inches and artwork rules. code gives just one.

code.description: e.g. GD64; leave out for all

tools.name: list_mockup_looks
tools.title: List mockup looks (model photos)
tools.description: Our real photo looks for one garment, model shots first, with the colors each has. For "a model wearing it": get_mockup with look set to the model look modelLookFor names for that color. No tool generates a model photo with AI. With designId, the first few show that design. Free. The client shows these pictures to the person: refer to each by its label, and never write a preview link as a markdown image. Give it as a plain link only if the person asks to open or download it, or can't see it, and do not generate, draw or edit your own version of the shirt, design or product.

tools.name: list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: Orders, newest first (limit 1 gives the latest), each with its status and a plain-words progress note. get_order has the lines, tracking and payment.

tools.name: purchase_order
tools.title: Pay for an order
tools.description: Pay for an order with the account's card: real money. BEFORE calling it, tell the person the total (shipping included) and ask them to confirm; call it only after they say yes, unless they clearly asked to pay right now ("buy it now", "go ahead and pay"). "Order", "make an order" or "order these" alone is NOT that: create the order, show the total, and ask. Pass the quoteId and totalCents of the order's offer (create_order, update_order or get_order). The same idempotencyKey never charges twice. If paying is not set up (Owner only, a spending limit, a card), the order is held, nothing is charged, and the result says what the person must do.

totalCents.description: The offer's total, as told to the person

accepted.description: Older form: the whole offer object instead of quoteId and totalCents

idempotencyKey.description: Any unique string; reuse it on a retry

tools.name: retry_order
tools.title: Retry a held order
tools.description: Try paying for a held order again (an earlier attempt is checked first, so nothing is charged twice). BEFORE calling it, tell the person the total and ask them to confirm, unless they clearly asked to pay for this order right now. Needs an idempotencyKey; a refusal charges nothing.

tools.name: update_order
tools.title: Edit a draft order
tools.description: Change the recipient or lines of an order that was never paid (no payment tried). It is quoted again: offer has the new quoteId and total, nextStep how to pay. The lines given replace all the lines.

country.description: US (the only country we ship to)

title.description: Line title, e.g. the design name

retailLineTotal.description: Optional: what your customer paid for this line, for your revenue figure only

RetailLineTotal.description: Optional. What your customer paid for this line in total (quantity × your price, after discounts, before tax and shipping): integer cents (amount × 100) and an upper-case ISO 4217 currency. Informational only: it counts toward your revenue figure and never changes the quote, the charge or what is printed. It is not part of the replay body, so a replay that differs only here returns the existing order.

tools.name: upload_artwork
tools.title: Upload artwork
tools.description: Upload a PNG and get an artwork id for create_design, with how large it can print. Pass pngUrl (a public HTTPS link; preferred) or pngBase64, not both. A file on the person's computer: ask them to upload it at https://toolboxpod.com/app/library?tab=artwork, then find it with list_artwork.

pngUrl.description: Public HTTPS link to the PNG

pngBase64.description: The PNG bytes, base64 (long strings get cut by chat clients: prefer pngUrl)

byteSize.description: Optional check: the file's size in bytes

tools.name: use_design_version
tools.title: Use this version
tools.description: Chooses this version as the design and makes its print file (free). Once the job is ready, its artworkId goes to create_design.

tools.name: whoami
tools.title: Who am I
tools.description: Call this first. Returns the account, the person's role, its stores and readiness: whether orders can be paid now and, if not, nextSteps, each with the website link that fixes it. Call it again after the person has done a step.

resources.name: garment-catalog
resources.title: Garment catalog
resources.description: The shirts Toolbox POD prints on: every color, size and print area, and the artwork rules. No prices (get_rates has them).

resources.name: ordering-guide
resources.title: How ordering works
resources.description: From design to doorstep: mockups, approving, prices, orders, who can pay, printing, US shipping, tracking, cancelling and problems.

resources.name: artwork-guide
resources.title: Design and artwork guide
resources.description: What prints well: file type, size and resolution, transparent backgrounds, each shirt's print area, and AI designs.

resources.name: selling-guide
resources.title: Selling in your store
resources.description: How selling your designs in your own WooCommerce or Shopify store works: publishing, prices, orders, shipping and tracking.

prompts.name: get_started
prompts.title: Get started
prompts.description: See what you can do here, check your Toolbox POD account, and find out whether you're ready to order.

prompts.name: design_from_idea
prompts.title: Design a shirt from an idea
prompts.description: Describe an idea and Toolbox AI draws a print-ready design; pick the version you like and see it on a shirt.

prompts.name: design_from_artwork
prompts.title: Turn my artwork into a shirt
prompts.description: Put your own picture (a PNG) on a shirt: check that it prints sharp, place it, and see the mockup.

prompts.name: change_design
prompts.title: Change a design
prompts.description: Change one of your designs (size, position, side, shirt or art), or bring back an earlier version of it.

prompts.name: show_design_on_shirts
prompts.title: Show a design on shirts
prompts.description: See one of your designs on shirts in the colors you pick: flat, folded or on a model.

prompts.name: compare_shirts
prompts.title: Compare shirt options
prompts.description: Compare the shirts you can print on: colors, sizes, print area and what each costs.

prompts.name: price_an_order
prompts.title: Price an order
prompts.description: Find out what an order would cost, shipping included, without creating anything.

prompts.name: order_shirts
prompts.title: Order shirts
prompts.description: Order shirts of one of your designs for yourself or a group: collect sizes and the address, check the total with you, then pay only after your yes.

prompts.name: reorder
prompts.title: Order again
prompts.description: Order the same shirts as an earlier order again, with any changes to sizes, color or address.

prompts.name: change_or_cancel_order
prompts.title: Change or cancel an order
prompts.description: Change the sizes, color or address of an order that isn't paid yet, throw away a draft, or ask support to cancel a paid order before it prints.

prompts.name: track_order
prompts.title: Where is my order?
prompts.description: See where an order is: its status, anything holding it up and how to fix it, and package tracking.

prompts.name: get_help_with_order
prompts.title: Get help with an order
prompts.description: Tell support about a problem with an order (a misprint, damage, a lost package, an address or billing question) and get a reference.
